title: Beethoven Symphony No 5 & 8 Fidelio CD Bernstein Vienna Time Life Deutsche
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Ludwig van Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C Minor, Op. 67; Symphony No. 8
in F, Op. 93; Fidelio Overture, Op. 72b. The Beethoven Collection,
Time-Life Music / Deutsche Grammophon, BTD-01A. Made for Time-Life Music
in West Germany.

Vienna Philharmonic Orchestra; Leonard Bernstein, conductor.

Symphony No. 5 in C Minor, Op. 67
1. Allegro con brio (8:38)
2. Andante con moto (10:19)
3. Allegro (5:23)
4. Allegro (11:17)

Symphony No. 8 in F, Op. 93
5. Allegro vivace e con brio (9:43)
6. Allegretto scherzando (4:00)
7. Tempo di menuetto (4:47)
8. Allegro vivace (7:20)

Fidelio Overture, Op. 72b
9. Allegro (7:13)

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
